description: Quote the exact Gold price to create a video using owned image, audio or video references. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_reference_to_video with the same inputs and quote_token.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

audio_id.description: Optional owned gallery reference audio UUID, where supported by the model.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting reference-to-video; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

prompt.description: What happens in the video, written for the chosen model. chargen_list_media_models with this mode says how to phrase it for each model (prompt_styles); nothing improves the wording on the way to the model.

reference_image_ids.description: Owned reference image UUIDs, where supported. Reference-to-video needs at least one image, audio or video reference; model-specific source counts are validated by the media policy.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

video_id.description: Optional owned gallery reference video UUID, where supported by the model.

name: chargen_quote_reference_to_video
title: Quote reference to video
